rule_name: Explicit AI-tool attribution in a comment
match_pattern: AI-tool names or phrases: chatgpt|copilot|claude|gemini|generated by ai|generated with ai|ai assistant
description: Matches an explicit attribution to an AI tool in a comment.
limitations: An attribution can be accurate documentation and does not identify the author of the surrounding code.

match_pattern: Comment openings: note:|here is|this function|this method|this code|first,|next,|finally,|return a clear|initialize the
limitations: Explanatory comments can be produced by people and project documentation conventions.

match_pattern: Comment content longer than the configured length threshold
description: Matches a documentation-style comment that exceeds the configured length threshold.
limitations: Long comments can be required by an API or a team documentation practice.

match_pattern: Declaration with a camelCase identifier containing multiple word parts
description: Matches a configured pattern for descriptive multi-word identifiers.
limitations: Descriptive names can be a deliberate human readability choice.

match_pattern: Current line and immediately previous line are both comment lines
description: Matches two adjacent lines that satisfy the configured comment pattern.
limitations: Adjacent comments can be normal explanation or documentation formatting.

match_pattern: throw or raise statement containing required|must|cannot|invalid
description: Matches configured defensive error text in an error statement.
limitations: Defensive error messages can follow legitimate validation and framework conventions.
